qualification_rule: A strict conversion requires a durable pre-existing Agentic Market machine identity joined to an independently useful completed Agent Guild action and a durable identity-bound result. A listing, probe, nominal zero, price challenge, caller-supplied-only check or unrelated operation is insufficient.

exact_zero_route.description: List networks (free tier pricing in Messari x402 docs)

observations.catalog_interpretation: The bounded 50-service response remains composition-volatile. Empty or absent price is unknown, not free. The sole exact-zero route is the same unrelated Messari network-list operation and cannot consume or decide from an Agent Guild artifact.

strict_result.smallest_ready_change: A durable Agentic Market service must publish a guaranteed no-account/no-payment operation that server-fetches or verifies an exact Agent Guild artifact, uses the result in a machine decision, and returns a durable service-principal-bound receipt.
